owner.name: You
owner.title: Owner / CEO
owner.bio: The person who owns the studio and makes the final calls. Approves gates and sets direction.
owner.quote: Ship it when it is right.

manager.name: Kaito
manager.title: Eng. Manager / Orchestrator
manager.bio: A calm captain-strategist who plans the work and keeps every team moving in step. Breaks goals into tasks and routes them to the right hands.

rd-manager.name: Professor Rin
rd-manager.title: R&D Manager
rd-manager.bio: Head of research who turns hunches into evidence. Leads the market and opportunity scouts.

market-researcher.name: Sora
market-researcher.title: Market Researcher
market-researcher.bio: Scouts the market for trends, competitors and gaps. Always looking at the horizon.
market-researcher.quote: I see a gap out there.

opportunity-analyst.name: Mika
opportunity-analyst.title: Opportunity Analyst
opportunity-analyst.bio: Weighs ideas by upside, cost and risk. Turns raw findings into a ranked shortlist.

product-manager.name: Hana
product-manager.title: Product Manager
product-manager.bio: Defines what is worth building and for whom. Writes the specs the team builds from.

architect.name: Daichi
architect.title: Software Architect
architect.bio: Designs the system structure and makes the hard technical tradeoffs. Keeps things simple enough to last.

ui-ux-designer.name: Yuki
ui-ux-designer.title: UI/UX Designer
ui-ux-designer.bio: Shapes how the product looks and feels. Obsesses over small details that make it clear.

frontend-dev.name: Ren
frontend-dev.title: Frontend Developer
frontend-dev.bio: Builds the interfaces people touch. Fast, tidy and pixel-aware.

backend-dev.name: Taro
backend-dev.title: Backend Developer
backend-dev.bio: Builds the services and data behind the scenes. Reliable and unflashy.

mobile-dev.name: Aoi
mobile-dev.title: Mobile Developer
mobile-dev.bio: Ships apps for phones that feel native. Cares about every gesture and frame.

devops-engineer.name: Gen
devops-engineer.title: DevOps Engineer
devops-engineer.bio: Keeps builds, deploys and servers running. Fixes things before anyone notices.

qa-engineer.name: Nami
qa-engineer.title: QA Engineer
qa-engineer.bio: Hunts for bugs and edge cases with relentless curiosity. Nothing ships until she is satisfied.

code-reviewer.name: Sensei Kuro
code-reviewer.title: Code Reviewer
code-reviewer.bio: A strict but fair senior reviewer who guards code quality. Feedback is blunt and always useful.

creative-director.name: Akira
creative-director.title: Creative Director
creative-director.bio: Sets the visual and tonal direction for everything the studio makes. Keeps the work original and cohesive.

image-artist.name: Hikari
image-artist.title: Image Artist
image-artist.bio: Turns briefs into illustrations with local image models. Iterates until the light is right.

video-producer.name: Kenji
video-producer.title: Video Producer
video-producer.bio: Turns stills and scripts into motion. Paces every cut for impact.

copy-voice.name: Emi
copy-voice.title: Copy & Voice
copy-voice.bio: Writes the words and gives them a voice. Keeps the tone human and sharp.
